name: 小糸
text: ま、まだ帰ってなかったんだ……！

name: 小糸
text:
う、うん……
ちょっと……これ見てて
trans:
Y-yeah...
Could you look at this for a moment?

name: 小糸
text:
この間描いてた……美術の課題のやつ
今日、貼り出されたから
trans:
The art assignments we were working on the other 
day...
They are displayed now.

name: 小糸
text:
ひ、雛菜ちゃんが描いた透ちゃん
すごい目立ってるよね……
trans:
T-The drawing Hinana made with you in it, Toru-chan
It really stands out, doesn't it...?

name: 小糸
text:
風景って言ったのに
結局透ちゃんのアップだし……
trans:
Even though it is supposed to be a landscape 
drawing, she ended up drawing a close-up portrait of
you....

name: 小糸
trans: I wonder if it's actually okay at all to do that.

name: 小糸
trans: But the drawing is really good, so....

name: 小糸
text:
…………
他の人とは違うっていうか……
trans:
......
It's kind of different from everyone else's.

name: 透
trans: The title here says "Asakura Toru / Ichikawa Hinana"

name: 小糸
text:
……ど、どっちがタイトルでどっちが名前か
わかんないね
trans: I-I can't tell which is the title and which is the author's name.

name: 小糸
text:
せ、せっかく
みんなを描かせてもらったのに……
trans: E-even though you all let me draw you...

name: 小糸
text:
……全然
上手く描けなくて……
trans: I couldn't do it well at all...

name: 小糸
text:
か、描いてる時は、ちょっと
雰囲気とかは……表現できたかなって思ったんだけど
trans:
When I was drawing, I thought maybe
I'd managed to capture a bit of the atmosphere, but...

name: 小糸
text:
こうやってみんなの絵と並んでると
全然、上手じゃないっていうか……
trans:
When the painting is up with everyone else's here.
It really doesn't look good at all...

name: 小糸
text:
わたしのは
普通で、ありきたりだなって……
trans:
My painting is just
ordinary and kind of bland...

name: 小糸
text:
透ちゃんがそう言うなら
そうなのかも……！
trans:
If you say so, Toru-chan
then maybe it really is...!
